svg.title: Wiecon Time Tracker
svg.desc: A Windows desktop app that turns raw punch-clock rows into monthly hours-worked timesheets. Four raw punch rows for one employee are paired into two working days, 8.58 and 8.48 hours, giving a January total of 17.06 hours.

g.text: Monthly hours, ready to file, out.
punch file · one row per punch, no in/out
